"Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1852 by J. H. Colton." Printed by Lang & Cooper, N.Y. General map of eastern Virginia, Maryland, Delaware, southern Pennsylvania, and northern North Carolina. Description derived from published bibliography. Scale ca. 1:750,000. LC Civil War Maps (2nd ed.), 479.2 Available also through the Library of Congress web site as raster image.
